findings.title: Apache Log4Shell Remote Code Execution
findings.description: Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 JNDI lookups allow remote code execution.

findings.title: Spring4Shell — Spring Framework RCE
findings.description: Remote code execution via data binding in Spring MVC / WebFlux.

findings.title: Zerologon — Netlogon Privilege Escalation
findings.description: Cryptographic flaw in Netlogon allows unauthenticated domain compromise.

findings.title: Microsoft Outlook NTLM Hash Leak
findings.description: Specially crafted email leaks NTLM hash without user interaction.

findings.title: Pulse Secure VPN Arbitrary File Read
findings.description: Unauthenticated file read enabling credential theft on Pulse VPN.
findings.solution: Upgrade to Pulse Connect Secure 9.0R3.4 or later.

findings.title: HTTP Security Headers Missing
findings.description: Missing X-Frame-Options, CSP, and HSTS headers allow clickjacking.
findings.solution: Configure web server to send recommended security headers.

findings.title: Weak TLS Cipher Suites Enabled
findings.description: RC4 and 3DES cipher suites are enabled — susceptible to BEAST/SWEET32.
findings.solution: Disable deprecated cipher suites in TLS configuration.
